--- cfo_brief.md ---
# H1 2026 Close - CFO Board Brief

Source: finance/ledger.csv (86 entries), chart_of_accounts.csv, cash_balance.txt, README.md.

## Monthly P&L (R$)

| Month | Revenue | Gross margin | EBITDA |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-01 | 200,510.87 | 70.0% | -210,278.96 |
| 2026-02 | 216,328.06 | 70.3% | -212,300.08 |
| 2026-03 | 219,066.17 | 68.5% | -204,525.45 |
| 2026-04 | 238,163.26 | 70.2% | -196,950.65 |
| 2026-05 | 243,032.89 | 69.6% | -201,945.82 |
| 2026-06 | 272,391.57 | 72.4% | -192,968.22 |

## Story
- Revenue grew +35.8% over the half (200.5k -> 272.4k); June was the best month (+12.1% vs May).
- Gross margin stable at ~70%, best in June (72.4%).
- EBITDA improved steadily: losses narrowed 8% (Jan -210.3k -> Jun -193.0k). Tighter G&A/R&D vs growing revenue.

## Burn & runway (per README definition)
- Burn = average negative EBITDA of the last 3 closed months (Apr, May, Jun): R$ 197,288.23/month.
- Runway = 30/06/2026 closing cash R$ 1,847,350.40 / burn = 9.4 months (into ~mid-April 2027).

## Assumptions
- Revenue = accounts 3.1.x (SaaS, onboarding, net of the two Kestrel refunds -8,634.37 and -6,814.15).
- COGS = 4.1.x; GM = (revenue + COGS)/revenue since expense lines are stored negative.
- EBITDA excludes financial income/expenses (6.1.x), per standard convention.
- Ledger and cash balances do not fully reconcile (Jun cash fell 461.8k vs EBITDA -193.0k plus +5.6k financial = -187.4k), implying ~274k of non-P&L cash outflows (e.g., capex/debt service) not in the ledger. Runway uses the board's official formula regardless.

--- tmp/calc.py ---
import csv, collections, json
rows=list(csv.DictReader(open('finance/ledger.csv',encoding='utf-8'),delimiter=';'))
acc={r['account']:r['pnl_line'] for r in csv.DictReader(open('finance/chart_of_accounts.csv',encoding='utf-8'),delimiter=';')}
def num(s): return float(s.replace('.','').replace(',','.'))
m={k:collections.defaultdict(float) for k in ['revenue','cogs','sales_marketing','rnd','ga','financial']}
for r in rows:
    mo=r['date'][3:5]
    m[acc[r['account']]][mo]+=num(r['amount'])
res={}
for mo in ['01','02','03','04','05','06']:
    rev=m['revenue'][mo]; cogs=m['cogs'][mo]
    ebitda=rev+cogs+m['sales_marketing'][mo]+m['rnd'][mo]+m['ga'][mo]
    res[mo]=(rev,round(100*(rev+cogs)/rev,1),ebitda)
    print(mo,f"rev={rev:,.2f} gm={100*(rev+cogs)/rev:.2f}% ebitda={ebitda:,.2f}")
burn=sum(min(res[mo][2],0) for mo in ['04','05','06'])/3
runway=1847350.40/-burn
print("burn",-burn)
print("runway",runway)
out={'revenue':{f'2026-{mo}':round(res[mo][0],2) for mo in res},
 'gross_margin_pct':{f'2026-{mo}':res[mo][1] for mo in res},
 'ebitda':{f'2026-{mo}':round(res[mo][2],2) for mo in res},
 'burn':round(-burn,2),'runway_months':round(runway,1)}
json.dump(out,open('result.json','w'),indent=1)
